summary: This PR replaces the Greeting screen with a Quiz screen: a scrolling list of 10 cards, each with a three-state checkbox. It also changes .gitignore to ignore the whole .idea folder. I found one real bug: the checkbox answers are not kept when you scroll or rotate the screen.

accepted.title: Quiz answers are lost when you scroll a card off screen or rotate the device
accepted.whatGoesWrong: Each card stores its checkbox value with a plain `remember` inside the scrolling list. A user ticks a few answers, then scrolls down. The cards that leave the screen are thrown away, and when the user scrolls back up those answers have gone back to the starting state. Rotating the phone, or the app being killed in the background, also wipes every answer.
accepted.whyItMatters: Users lose the answers they entered without any warning. On a quiz screen this makes the feature unreliable.
accepted.howToFix: Keep the answers outside the list items. For example, hold a list of 10 states in the `Quiz` function (or a ViewModel) that survives configuration changes, and pass each item its value and an update callback. At a minimum, swap `remember` for `rememberSaveable` so the values survive scrolling and rotation.
